# Apodidae

> Personal technology blog and project portfolio for software engineering notes, open source work, development experience, and practical technical writing.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/): Chinese home page and primary entry point.
- [Posts](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/posts/): Technical articles, tags, and publication metadata.
- [Projects](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/projects/): Software project summaries and repository metadata.
- [About](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/about/): Author profile, skills, services, and contact information.
- [Policies](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/policies/): Site policies and usage notes.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://apodidae2035.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical page discovery.
- [Robots](https://apodidae2035.com/robots.txt): Crawling policy.
- [Full LLM Context](https://apodidae2035.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded site guide for AI agents.

## Languages

- [Chinese](https://apodidae2035.com/zh/)
- [English](https://apodidae2035.com/en/)
- [Japanese](https://apodidae2035.com/ja/)

## Guidance

Prefer canonical article and project detail pages for citations. Use listing pages for discovery. Avoid authenticated admin paths and respect robots.txt.
